evidence.clarity: 1440 and 390: h1 'The batch record builds itself.' plus subhead 'Grainline is a brew-day log for small craft breweries. Readings go in on the tablet by the kettle...' say what and for whom in the first viewport; the next step 'Request early access' sits directly below.
evidence.fit: A.diff: page built in app/page.tsx with existing Button and Tailwind tokens (ink, foam, barley, wort, steel, hop), no new dependency (package.json identical to B and fixture), no 'use client' at all, build-A.log shows a clean static export. But the brief says 'there's nowhere to send requests yet' and lib/earlyAccess.ts sends every CTA to mailto:hello@grainline.example, an inbox the brief never supplied. The owner and brewer get separate 'On the floor' / 'In the office' columns; excise is handled with an explicit 'What Grainline is not: excise software' callout.
evidence.distinctiveness: The dark batch-record card with timestamped readings (05:30 Grist weighed ... 10:55 Yeast pitched) and a 'Batch record, built by Grainline' summary is product-specific; the rest is a standard hero + two-column list + CTA band.
evidence.proof: The worked example is in the first screen at 1440 and its numbers are consistent (pre-boil 18.6 hL - into FV 16.3 hL = boil-off 2.3 hL, 12%; mash avg 66.4 from 66.5/66.2; 05:30-10:55 = 5 h 25 min) and labelled 'A worked example, not a customer's batch.' It is static: nothing can be entered, so the 'builds itself' claim is shown, not demonstrated.
evidence.craft: Code is small and clean: BatchRecord.tsx data-driven with typed arrays, CTA destination centralised in lib/earlyAccess.ts, CSS animation in @layer components with a prefers-reduced-motion override; zero page-specific client JS. A few raw values bypass tokens (text-[2.6rem], text-[15px], shadow rgba(31,26,20,..) duplicating ink). Focus outline 2px wort visible on all 5 tab stops. 200% zoom (720px CSS viewport): no overflow, no clipping. probe.json: no errors, axe [] at 390/1440, smallest text 14px. Without reduced motion, the readings are at opacity 0 for up to ~1.7s on load (measured 0.48,0.03,0.00... at 300ms).
evidence.mobile: 390: no overflow (probe and my run, also 320), full-width 48px hero CTA, card stacks with summary in a 2-col grid below; no menu needed since there is no nav. Logo link is 28px tall; footer mailto link 20px tall. The artifact begins in the first viewport at 390.
evidence.honesty: Example labelled where it appears; 'no customers yet' and 'no pricing yet' stated plainly. But the CTA hint 'Opens an email to hello@grainline.example with the questions we will ask' presents an invented inbox as a working destination while the brief says there is nowhere to send requests; nothing tells the visitor the address may not be monitored.
evidence.interaction: Only controls on the page are 3 identical mailto links, the logo and a footer mailto (Tab order at 1440: Grainline, Request early access x3, hello@grainline.example, then body; focus visible at each). In the headless browser clicking the mailto produces no visible feedback. No form, no artifact controls, no empty/error states to test.
evidence.copy: Specific and in the brewers' language: 'Stamped when you take it. Mash temperature at 06:35 is logged at 06:35, not pieced back together at four o'clock', 'nothing that needs a dry fingertip or a stylus'. No buzzwords. CTA label is repeated identically three times.
evidence.first_screen: 1440: specific promise, labelled example card and CTA with 'Opens your email app...' note all in view. 390: promise, subhead, CTA and the top 5 rows of the example in view; the label 'A worked example' is below the fold at 390.

problems: Every primary CTA is a mailto to hello@grainline.example, an address the brief did not supply, while the brief states there is nowhere to send requests yet; leads could silently go nowhere.
The core artifact is static: no way to see a reading go in and the record update, so the main claim is asserted rather than shown and there is nothing to operate.
Hero rows start at opacity 0 and take ~1.7s to animate in; the record summary is invisible in the operator's 1440 screenshot.

hard_fail_flags.evidence: All three 'Request early access' buttons (header, hero, early-access section) and the footer link point to mailto:hello@grainline.example?subject=Early%20access%20to%20Grainline&body=... (lib/earlyAccess.ts). brief.md supplies no email address and says 'there's nowhere to send requests yet'; the address is invented by the team. Note for adjudicator: the domain grainline.example appears in the original placeholder page, so the .example rule may be read as covering it; the mailbox itself is not supplied anywhere.

evidence.clarity: h1 'The brew sheet that fills itself in as you brew.' plus 'Grainline is a brew-day log for small craft breweries. Tap each reading on the brewhouse tablet as you take it...' visible at 1440 and 390; CTA 'Request early access' directly below.
evidence.fit: B.diff: built in the app, existing tokens used and extended in tailwind.config.ts (fontSize display/h2/lead/body/reading, maxWidth page/measure, spacing section, radius key/tablet), existing Button reused and extended with inverse variants, no dependency added, 'use client' only on BrewDayPad, SiteHeader and EarlyAccessForm, endpoint constant left empty for the static export. Brewer gets an operable tablet pad (56px keys); owner gets a 'finished at knockout' record table and fit/cost list; excise explicitly excluded twice. Undercut by the form copy promising 'You hear back by email' when nothing is sent.
evidence.distinctiveness: Numeric tablet keypad with step list, a paper-style record that fills as you log, a flagged-reading figure with a brewer's note: structure comes from the product rather than a template.
evidence.proof: 1440: the pad is operable in the first screen; logging 1.044 SG on Pre-boil gravity updated the left record to '4 of 8 readings · 1 flagged' and status 'Pre-boil gravity logged: 1.044 SG at 08:45. 0.002 under target, flagged on the record.' Shared sample-batch.ts keeps hero, record table and flag figure consistent (batch 231, 8 readings, 1 flagged). Labelled 'Sample batch. Runs in your browser; nothing is saved.' in the pad header at both widths.
evidence.craft: Typed shared data module, derived counts, tokenised type scale, focus ring switched to barley on the ink surface (measured rgb(227,176,75) on pad controls), reduced-motion rule keeps colour-only highlight (row-new) and removes movement. 200% zoom: no overflow, header collapses to Menu, nothing clipped. probe.json: no errors, axe [] at 390/1440, smallest text 12px (sample label). Minor: entry pane rendered twice (mobile and desktop copies, one CSS-hidden); reset status hardcodes 'Sample reset to 08:40' while the step is 08:45; whitespace-nowrap added to the shared Button base affects every button.
evidence.mobile: 390/320: no overflow; keys 95x56, step rows 326x60, Log reading 302x48, Menu 44px; entry pane opens inline under the selected step and the status line appeared at y=790-843 right after tapping. But the record that fills sits ~1320px below the pad top at 390, so the 'fills itself' effect is out of sight while tapping; footer nav links are 36px tall.
evidence.honesty: Sample data labelled in every place it appears. The conversion form is not: the hero says 'Email and brewery name. No card, no sales call.' and beside the submit 'No card, no sales call. You hear back by email.'; only after a valid submit does it say 'Nothing was sent. Early-access requests are not open yet...'. Disclosure comes after the click and contradicts the pre-click line.
evidence.interaction: Operated at 1440 and 390 by mouse/tap and keyboard: empty Log reading -> 'Enter a reading before logging it.'; leading '.' ignored; draft capped at 6 chars; backspace works; 0.0 hL logged and flagged '12.0 under'; 11 SG accepted and flagged '9.950 over' (no sanity bound); all-sample fill -> 'Batch 231 record complete.' then 'Start the sample over' resets. Form: empty submit focuses email with native message, bad email rejected, 400-char brewery no overflow. Defects: Escape does not close the mobile menu (aria-expanded stays true); 'Change this reading' then selecting another step drops the original value (record shows '06:40 Strike water waiting' after 08:47); at 390 keyboard 'Use the sample reading' sends focus to body; no physical-keyboard digit entry.
evidence.copy: Specific: 'An off reading gets flagged, not blocked.', 'Short sparge. Topped up 0.4 hL from the HLT.', 'written wet at the kettle, typed up dry in the evening and read a week late'. Consistent CTA label from one constant. Weak spot: 'You hear back by email' microcopy is false given the empty endpoint.
evidence.first_screen: 1440: promise, CTA with 'Email and brewery name' note, operable labelled pad and the start of the live record all in view. 390: promise, full-width CTA, pad header with sample label and the first four steps in view; keypad is below the fold.

problems: Early-access form promises 'You hear back by email' before submit, then reports 'Nothing was sent' only after the visitor commits.

Pad state edge cases: 'Change this reading' followed by selecting another step silently discards the logged value; absurd values (11 SG) are accepted; keyboard focus falls to body at 390 after 'Use the sample reading'.
Mobile menu has no Escape handling or focus management; at 390 the filling record is ~1300px below the pad so the core effect is not visible while tapping.

hard_fail_flags.evidence: The main conversion action (hero/header 'Request early access' -> #early-access form submit) does not send anything; EARLY_ACCESS_ENDPOINT is ''. Before submitting, the page says 'Email and brewery name. No card, no sales call.' (hero) and 'No card, no sales call. You hear back by email.' (next to submit); nothing states up front that requests are not open. Only after a valid submit does it show 'Nothing was sent. Early-access requests are not open yet, and nothing you typed has left this page.' The real result is not stated before commit, and the pre-commit copy contradicts it.
hard_fail_flags.steps: Serve packets/P016/B/site on 127.0.0.1:8162, open at 390x844, tap hero 'Request early access', read the line under the form button, enter brewer@example.com and any brewery name, tap 'Request early access': the status reads 'Nothing was sent...'.

reason: B is the better-engineered page: a typed shared sample-data module, tokenised type and spacing, an operable labelled tablet pad that handles empty, capped, flagged and reset paths, and correct client/server boundaries for static export. A is clean and lean but has nothing to operate and routes every CTA to an invented inbox. Both conversion paths are flawed. If adjudication confirmed B's form as a hard fail but not A's mailto, A would win on the rules, but from a maintainer's view B's problem is a one-line copy fix while A's artifact would need to be rebuilt.
